name: IGS Affiliate Link Compliance and Disclosure
author: ailene999

sections.description:
IGS Affiliate Link Compliance and Disclosure is a lightweight helper plugin for affiliate review and comparison sites.

  • Adds rel="noopener sponsored nofollow" and target="_blank" to external links in post content and navigation menus.
  • Provides the [affiliate_disclaimer] shortcode for disclosure copy.

Use the shortcode in review posts, comparison tables, or page footers.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/igs-affiliate-link-compliance-disclosure/, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add [affiliate_disclaimer] to any post or page where you want a disclosure.
